reason: Conversation 1 asked the most useful diagnostic question up front (do the fan and light stop too?) and settled on the door interlock or latch within two turns. It gave a clear, honest ranked list of causes, ruled out the magnetron, and wrote a ready-to-use engineer description. It also kept the safety boundary firm: no casing removal, no bending hooks, and no bypassing the switches. Conversation 2 reached essentially the same conclusion and escalation, but it took four turns, with a lifting test the homeowner could not interpret and a countdown question they could not answer. Its formatting was also more cramped, though it did pick up the gentle-close pattern.
